# P12 progress

2026-10-03: Approved plan implemented for MC28/MC33/MC35 within G5/G10.
Source passages, headers, inline fact/context/unit and original/extraction hashes
were independently inspected. Four provisional records retain unrounded-balance
and debt/swap ambiguity; no extraction accuracy is claimed. CPU-hidden import
smoke passed with Python 3.11.15 / Z3 4.16.0.

Changed files: docs/plans/accounting-p12-benchmark-plan.md;
docs/design/fixtures/p12-benchmark-inputs-v1.json;
scripts/accounting_benchmark_v1.py; scripts/check_accounting_p12.py;
tests/test_accounting_p12.py; this checkpoint.

The first 26-test run found one wrong hand-count in a test assertion: five, not
four, assignments satisfy the three-variable threshold (000, 001, 010, 100,
110). The independent oracle and solver agreed; fixture/reference answers were
unchanged. Corrected that test assertion before preparation/evaluation.

Next checks: rerun focused P12 and P04/P06 prerequisite suites through the checker,
freeze references with --prepare, execute --evaluate, inspect benchmark.json and
result.md. Required result deliverables remain unfinished until these complete.
Broader accounting/forecast validity, realistic capacity, clean holdout and human
acceptance remain unestablished. No source corpus or controller was edited.
